method: Offline cost projection from the combined real dev sample and explicit dev metadata. No provider calls were made for this projection.

campaign_scope.campaign_formula: 3 * measured agent cost + 6 * first judge cost; follow-up turns run once without judges

contract_termination_case.classification: single-run route/status signal; no dependency error observed; not repeated

assumptions.unknown_42_cases_use_dev_replan_prevalen: 4/27, yielding 10.2222 expected replan cases across 69 total
assumptions.ordinary_dev_route_mix: 2 general_web, 5 knowledge, 3 mixed, 12 support, 1 handoff among 23 non-replan dev cases; ambiguous allowed routes assigned to the higher-cost measured category
assumptions.route_unit_costs: EX02 for general_web, EX01 for knowledge, EX05 for mixed, EX03 for support; the highest valid ordinary judge cost is used as the handoff proxy; four observed replan rows provide the replan mean
assumptions.web_search: One fixed US$0.01 web-search fee per general_web case and 0.5 per replan case, based on the observed replan paths; fee is already included in agent totals
assumptions.uncertainty_stress: 1.5x on variable agent-token and judge costs; fixed web-search fee is not multiplied; embedding allowance is based on observed ledger cost

qa_stratified_projection.decision: Does not fit the primary available balance; no campaign cap should be mounted.

independent_supervisor_sensitivity.basis: Supervisor's separate offline lower-bound check; assumes four measured replans, four general_web cases and 61 other cases, and no unobserved web cases in the sealed holdout.

mock_preflight.startup_result: process exited with empty stdout/stderr; GET /openapi.json failed

decision.campaign_gate: blocked by projected cost versus primary balance
decision.pricing_retry_gate: stopped before mock restart or paid retry because the full campaign projection already fails the available balance
decision.next_condition: A future run needs an approved higher persisted primary limit and a valid estimate within the campaign ceiling; the pricing cases also require a healthy versioned local mock service.
